title: Translation tools in healthcare
why: Language barriers cause harm. Translation tools help with simple communication and draft materials when no interpreter is immediately available.
what_is_different: For consent, diagnosis and complex instructions, a qualified interpreter is the standard. Machine translation is for simple, low-risk communication and for drafts that a native speaker reviews.

extra_modules.title: Safe use in clinical settings
extra_modules.outcome: You can: know when machine translation is and isn't acceptable
extra_modules.practice: List five situations in your work and decide tool vs interpreter for each

starter_project: Create a reviewed bilingual phrase sheet for common, low-risk interactions in your setting, plus a clear rule for when to call an interpreter.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
